newsitem.title: BELGIUM: No additional EU sugar production levy expected.
newsitem.headline: No additional EU sugar production levy expected.

text.p: No additional sugar production levy is expected for the 1996/97 marketing year (July to June) and there may be a cut in the B-quota levy, an EU official said on Thursday.

"The European Union's sugar management committee's financial review has shown that there is a cumulative financial surplus for last year and dating back to the 1991/92 marketing year which would mean no additional production levy for 1996/97 and a possible cut in the B-quota levy," the official said.
The current production levy is 39.5 percent of the white sugar intervention price.
The management committee will continue to review the production levy and a final decision will be reached in two weeks time.
"The forecast is provisional and is subject to change. The figures for the last two months of last year (1995/96) are estimates," the official added. --Chris White, Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800
